name: Odia Lens
description: Point at Odia words on any web page, in ePaper images, videos and PDF books: meaning, pronunciation and word origin. Offline; reads only the pages you turn it on for. Optional online translation, off until you turn it on.

action.default_title: Odia Lens: click to read Odia on this page (Alt+Shift+O)

toggle-lens.description: Turn the Odia Lens on or off on this page

toggle-frame.description: Open or close the Odia Lens frame: a box you move and resize over Odia in a picture

open-reader.description: Open the Odia Lens reader for PDF books and newspapers
